sections.description:
EXCISE DUTY ON PRODUCTION CAPACITY (COTTON FABRICS) RULES, 1968
EXCISE DUTY ON PRODUCTION CAPACITY (COTTON FABRICS)
RULES, 1968
(Amendment)
[Gazette of Pakistan, Part I,
5th September 1969]
S. R. O. 1734(K)/69.‑In
exercise of the powers conferred by sub section (4) of section 3 of the Central Excises and Salt Act, 1944 (I of
1944) read with section 37 thereof, the Central Board of Revenue, with the
prior approval of the Central Government, is pleased to direct that the
following further amendment shall be made in the Excise Duty on Produc tion
Capacity (Cotton Fabrics) Rules, 1968, namely In the aforesaid Rules, in rule 4, after sub‑rule (4), the
following new sub‑rule shall be added, namely
"(5) The abatement of duty
provided for in this rule may be allowed by the Central Board of Revenue, in
accordance with such procedure as may be approved by the Central Government in
this behalf, at the end of each quarter on a provisional basis and subject to
the final determination by the Board at the end of the financial year.".
[118/69 C. No. 2/70‑CX (PC. III)/68].
